description: This file defines an Android activity named 'DetailActivity' which displays detailed information about a recipe, including image, title, description, category, ingredients, steps, and a favorite toggle button. It interacts with a repository to fetch recipe data and manages UI updates accordingly.

classes.name: DetailActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific recipe, including image, description, ingredients, steps, and a favorite toggle button. It handles fetching data asynchronously and updating the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves recipe ID from intent, fetches recipe data asynchronously, and updates UI components accordingly.

methods.name: intent
methods.description: Helper method to create an intent to launch this activity with the specified recipe ID.
